sections.title: LinkedIn post
sections.body:
Most photo digitisation problems start before the scanner.

They start with not knowing what you have.

If you are sitting on a box of old prints and feeling stuck, North Quay Scan Desk is offering a 25 minute remote assessment of a household photograph collection.

Date and time: 19 February 2028 at 16:30 UTC
Cost: EUR 18
Format: remote, on camera

What we will do in the session:
• Look at up to six sample photographs on camera
• Identify key questions about their condition
• Talk through what a digitisation order could look like

What this is not:
• Not scanning
• Not restoration
• Not valuation
• No file delivery
• No promised turnaround time for any later digitisation

Point of view: a short, focused assessment can save you from guessing, and help you decide what to do next with confidence.

If a calm second set of eyes would help, this session is designed for that.
